answer_1.quote: we propose a new task called DimonGen: Diversified Generative Commonsense Reasoning. The task involves generating diverse sentences that describe the relationships between two given concepts...
answer_1.outputs: diverse sentences describing relationships between concepts

answer_2.quote: We use both N-gram-based metrics such as BLEU and ROUGE, as well as the concept overlapping rate (Success Rate) between the input and generated sentences.

answer_4.quote: we conduct the human evaluation by asking three annotators to assign grades (up to 5) of the generated relationship sentences.
answer_4.guideline: assign grades for quality, diversity, and grammar & fluency
